question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ 20 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ 20 \\ 5\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ 3 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- x_{2} \\ 0 \\ - x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 x_{3} \\ 5 x_{3} \\ x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ 20 \\ 5\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} \\ 5 x_{3} \\ 3 x_{1} - x_{2} + x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ 20 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=7 \\ 5 x_{3} &=20 \\ 3 x_{1} - x_{2} + x_{3} &=5\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 20 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 & 5\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 20 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 & 5\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 20 \\ 0 & 2 & -5 & -16\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-3)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 0 & 2 & -5 & -16 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 20\end{array}\right] && R_{2}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & - \frac{5}{2} & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 20\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & - \frac{5}{2} & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=7 \\ x_{2} - \frac{5 x_{3}}{2} &=-8 \\ x_{3} &=4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=4.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+\left(- \frac{5}{2}\right)(4)=-8\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=2
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-1)(2)+(2)(4)=7\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=1
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=1$, $x_2=2$, $x_3=4$, which means

$$
1a_1+(2)a_2+(4)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(1)+(2)+(4)=7.
$$

$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ -1 \\ 21\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- x_{2} \\ x_{2} \\ x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 x_{3} \\ 0 \\ 5 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ -1 \\ 21\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} \\ x_{2} \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ -1 \\ 21\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=11 \\ x_{2} &=-1 \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=21\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 11 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & 21\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 11 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & 21\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 11 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 & 10\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 11 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & 12\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-2)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 11 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=11 \\ x_{2} &=-1 \\ x_{3} &=4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=4.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(0)(4)=-1\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-1
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-1)(-1)+(2)(4)=11\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=2
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=2$, $x_2=-1$, $x_3=4$, which means

$$
2a_1+(-1)a_2+(4)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(2)+(-1)+(4)=5.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -5 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 11 \\ -2\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -5 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 11 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ 4 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- 2 x_{2} \\ - 5 x_{2} \\ - x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}3 x_{3} \\ 11 x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} \\ - 5 x_{2} + 11 x_{3} \\ 4 x_{1} - x_{2} - 2 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=2 \\ - 5 x_{2} + 11 x_{3} &=-4 \\ 4 x_{1} - x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &=15\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4 \\ 4 & -1 & -2 & 15\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4 \\ 4 & -1 & -2 & 15\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4 \\ 0 & 7 & -14 & 7\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-4)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 7 & -14 & 7 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4\end{array}\right] && R_{2}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=\left(\frac{1}{7}\right)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(5)R_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=2 \\ x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &=1 \\ x_{3} &=1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=1.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(-2)(1)=1\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=3
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-2)(3)+(3)(1)=2\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=5
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=5$, $x_2=3$, $x_3=1$, which means

$$
5a_1+(3)a_2+(1)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(5)+(3)+(1)=9.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}0 \\ x_{1} \\ 0\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{2} \\ 0 \\ - x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{3} \\ 2 x_{3} \\ 3 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{2} + x_{3} \\ x_{1} + 2 x_{3} \\ - x_{2} + 3 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{2} + x_{3} &=1 \\ x_{1} + 2 x_{3} &=1 \\ - x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=7\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{array}\right] && R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 8\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(1)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + 2 x_{3} &=1 \\ x_{2} + x_{3} &=1 \\ x_{3} &=2\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=2.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(1)(2)=1\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-1
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(0)(-1)+(2)(2)=1\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=-3
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=-3$, $x_2=-1$, $x_3=2$, which means

$$
-3a_1+(-1)a_2+(2)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(-3)+(-1)+(2)=-2.
$$

$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3} &=8 \\ 5 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 8 x_{3} &=1 \\ - 2 x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=-5\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 8 \\ 5 & 6 & -8 & 1 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & -5\end{array}\right]

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 8 \\ 5 & 6 & -8 & 1 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & -5\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -39 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & -5\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-5)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -39 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 11\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3} &=8 \\ x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &=-39 \\ 0 &=11\end{aligned}\right.
$$

However, the final equation $0=11$ gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.

Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ -6 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ -6 \\ 1\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{2} \\ 3 x_{2} \\ x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}3 x_{3} \\ 3 x_{3} \\ x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ -6 \\ 1\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} \\ 3 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}7 \\ -6 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=7 \\ 3 x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=-6 \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3} &=1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -6 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & 1\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -6 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & 1\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -6\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -6\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(- \frac{1}{2}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=7 \\ x_{2} + x_{3} &=-2 \\ x_{3} &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=3.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(1)(3)=-2\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-5
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(1)(-5)+(3)(3)=7\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=3
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=3$, $x_2=-5$, $x_3=3$, which means

$$
3a_1+(-5)a_2+(3)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3}=(3)+(-5)+(-3)=-5.
$$
